_comment: Hand-made builds that use only the 8 tier-1 piece ids in configs/pieces.yaml (all in LEGO Classic 10698). 'color' is optional on a part; omit it when any color works. Parts lists are piece counts, not step-by-step instructions.

builds.name: Simple tower
builds.description: Stack of 2x2 bricks with two small slopes as a pointed cap.

builds.name: Tall tower
builds.description: Twelve 2x2 bricks high, topped with one 2x2 slope.

builds.name: Criss-cross tower
builds.description: 2x4 bricks stacked, each layer turned 90 degrees.

builds.name: Lighthouse
builds.description: Wide 2x4 base, a 2x2 column, a ring of 1x1 'lamp' bricks and a slope roof.

builds.name: Hollow square tower
builds.description: 4x4 hollow tower, 6 layers (two 1x4 + two 1x2 per layer, turned each layer), 2x2 slope roof.

builds.name: Castle turret
builds.description: Hollow 4x4 tower with 1x1 battlements on the corners.

builds.name: Low wall
builds.description: 8 studs long, 4 rows, offset like real bricks (1x2 half-bricks at the ends).

builds.name: Long wall
builds.description: 12 studs long, 4 rows, offset pattern.

builds.name: Thick wall
builds.description: Two studs thick, 8 long, 4 rows of 2x4 bricks offset with 2x2 bricks.

builds.name: Castle wall
builds.description: Low wall with 1x1 battlements along the top.

builds.name: Wall with window
builds.description: 8 studs long, 5 rows, with a 2-stud window gap and a 1x2 plate sill.

builds.name: Garden fence
builds.description: 1x1 posts joined by 1x4 rails, plates as caps.

builds.name: Flat bridge
builds.description: Two 2x2 pillars three bricks high, a deck of overlapping 1x4 bricks, plate edges.

builds.name: Ramp bridge
builds.description: Short pillars, a 2x4 deck and 2x2 slopes as ramps at both ends.

builds.name: Footbridge with railings
builds.description: 2x2 pillars, 2x4 deck and 1x1 railing posts.

builds.name: Long bridge
builds.description: Three pillars, a staggered 2x4 deck and slope ramps.

builds.name: Step bridge
builds.description: Stairs up and down made of 2x4 bricks, with a 2x2 landing on top.

builds.name: Doghouse
builds.description: 2x4 floor, short walls with a doorway, two 2x2 slopes as the roof.

builds.name: Hut
builds.description: 4x4 hut, 3 rows high with a door gap, 2x2 slope roof.

builds.name: Tiny house
builds.description: 6x4 house, 4 rows with door gap, two rows of 2x2 slopes as the roof.

builds.name: House with chimney
builds.description: Tiny house plus a 1x1 chimney and small slopes on the gable ends.

builds.name: Garage
builds.description: 6x4 walls with a wide opening and a flat roof of 2x4 bricks.

builds.name: Cottage
builds.description: 8x6 house with door, 1x2 plate doorstep and a full slope roof.

builds.name: Two-story house
builds.description: Two floors of 6x4 walls with a 2x4 brick floor between them, slope roof.
